name: CUSTOMERS BANCORP INC
description: Customers Bancorp Inc is a bank holding company conducting banking activities through its wholly owned subsidiary, Customers Bank. The Bank provides commercial and consumer customers the stability of a regulated financial institution supported by risk management. It serves commercial and corporate businesses nationwide, including healthcare, real estate, specialty finance, fund finance, technology and venture capital banking, mortgage finance and commercial equipment financing, and provides payments and treasury services. The Bank also serves consumers through its branch network, offering residential mortgages and personal loan and deposit products, including Banking-as-a-Service, with services delivered predominantly in Southeastern and Central Pennsylvania, New York, and other states.
